name: Lokalise AI
tagline: Lokalise is a translation management platform with integrated AI translation, glossary management, and quality assurance tools. Development teams use it to localise apps, websites, and digital products into 100+ languages. Its AI translation engine combines machine translation with brand-specific terminology for consistent localisation.
